title: Gauhati High Court
raw_text: Denying anticipatory bail to Pawan Khera in connection with an FIR filed by Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma's wife, the Gauhati High Court today observed that the Congress leader had dragged an 'innocent lady' into the controversy to gain political mileage.Noting that it is not a case of defamation simpliciter, a bench of Justice Parthivjyoti Saikia categorically remarked that a custodial interrogation was necessary in this case to identify Khera's associates who collected and provided him...
